assan.g: “gihī, upāsako, ārāmiko, sāmaṇero, titthiyo, titthiyasāvako, assamaṇo, asakyaputtiyo assan”ti imāni aṭṭha padāni “assan”ti iminā bhāvavikappākārena vuttāni.
piyacakkhūhi sampassitabbo, sinehuppattiyā padaṭṭhānabhūto bhaveyyanti vuttaṁ hoti.
aratiyā ratiyā ca saho abhibhavitā ajjhottharitā bhaveyyaṁ.
lābhāsāya saṁvaraṇasīlaparipūraṇaṁ pāḷiyaṁ āgataṁ kimīdisaṁ bhagavā anujānātīti? Na bhagavā sabhāvena īdisaṁ anujānāti, mahākāruṇikatāya pana puggalajjhāsayena evaṁ vuttanti dassento “
piyāyitabbo piyacakkhūhi passitabbo pemaniyo bhaveyyanti attho.
yadi ahaṁ rodeyyaṁ, kisā parisukkhasarīrā bhaveyyaṁ.
Tusitabhavanato cavitvā manussattaṁ āgato punabhave anivatti1 assaṁ, sabbaññutaṁ sampāpuṇeyyanti vadati.

Assan.g: hi uttamapurisappayoge ahaṁ- saddo appayuttopi payutto eva hoti.
hi uttamapurisayoge ahaṁ-saddo appayuttopi ayaṁ-saddena parāmasanato payutto viya hoti.
